exercises.instructionEn: Read the summary of the two episodes and underline the correct linking words.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki qism xulosasini o'qing va to'g'ri bog'lovchi so'zlar tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI QISMNING QISQAChA MAZMUNI.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  Sandra and David went to meet
  Senan 1) BECAUSE they wanted to
  write an article about a shark
  caller. Senan asked them to eat
  sweet potatoes 2) AND to go to bed
  early. The next morning, 3) AS they
  were leaving the beach, they saw a
  man, Mosan. He was very angry with
  Senan 4) AND cursed him. 5) WHEN
  Sandra, David and Senan were in the
  canoe, Senan started beating the
  water with coconut shells. Some
  fins appeared. Sandra thought they
  were sharks, 6) BUT they were
  dolphins. Senan was surprised
  7) BECAUSE his magic didn't work.
  Suddenly, it started raining
  8) AND David asked Senan to take
  them back to the shore. Senan
  couldn't move his arms, 9) SO David
  asked Sandra to give him the
  paddle. 10) WHEN they were back on
  the shore, Mosan and Senan had an
  argument. David and Sandra decided
  to leave the village. 11) AFTER
  they left the village, Sandra found
  some meat in one of Senan's
  coconuts.


⚠ BOG'LOVChILAR:

  because = chunki (SABAB)
  so = shuning uchun (NATIJA)
  and = va (QO'ShISh)
  but = lekin (QARAMA-QARShILIK)
  when = ...ganda (VAQT)
  as = ... ekan, ... paytida (VAQT)
  after = ...dan keyin
  before = ...dan oldin
  until = ...gacha
  while = ... paytida


⚠ 'BECAUSE' va 'SO' FARQI:

  A because B = A, chunki B
     (B - sabab)
  A so B = A, shuning uchun B
     (B - natija)

  9-band: 'Senan couldn't move his
  arms, SO David asked ...' -
  NATIJA → 'so'.


⚠ 'AS' = 'WHILE':

  3-band: 'AS they were leaving the
  beach' = plyajdan ketayotgan
  paytda.
  ⚠ 'until' mos emas: 'ketguncha
  ko'rdi' ma'nosiz.


⚠ 'TO CURSE':

  = la'natlamoq.
  ⚠ 1-qism nomi 'The Curse' = la'nat.


⚠ 'A FIN':

  = suzgich (baliq, akula).


⚠ 'TO HAVE AN ARGUMENT':

  = janjallashmoq.
  ⚠ 'to argue' (fe'l).

HIKOYaNING DAVOMI - TO'LIQ MATNI VA
TARJIMASI.


⚠ 1-QISMDAN ESLATMA (24-25-betlar):

  Sandra va David - 'The Morning Sun'
  gazetasi muxbirlari. Ular Tinch
  okeanidagi Kontu qishlog'iga
  akulalarni chaqira oladigan odam -
  Senan haqida yozish uchun kelgan.


⚠ 2-QISM QISQACHA:

  Senan Sandra va Davidni qayiqda
  dengizga olib chiqadi. Akula
  o'rniga DELFINLAR keladi, yomg'ir
  boshlanadi. Senan 'menga sehr
  qilishdi' deydi. David eshkak bilan
  qirg'oqqa qaytaradi. Qirg'oqda
  Senan boshqa erkak bilan
  janjallashadi. Sandra kokos ichida
  GO'ShT topadi - Senan akulalarni
  sehr bilan emas, go'sht bilan
  chaqirmoqchi bo'lgan!


⚠ 'BAD MAGIC':

  = yomon sehr.
  ⚠ 'magic' - SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'TO CAST A SPELL ON SB':

  = kimgadir sehr qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'a spell' = sehr, afsun.
  ⚠ 'cast' - noto'g'ri fe'l:
  cast - cast - cast.
  ⚠ 'to break a spell' = sehrni
  buzmoq (5-kadrda).


⚠ 'THE MAN WAS RIGHT':

  1-qismda bir odam ularni
  ogohlantirgan edi. Sandra o'shani
  eslaydi.


⚠ 'A SHARK CALLER' va
  'A FISHERMAN':

  shark caller = akula chaqiruvchi
  fisherman = baliqchi
  ⚠ 5-kadrda: 'You are a fisherman,
  not a shark caller' - ya'ni sen
  oddiy baliqchisan, sehrgar emas.

tasks.en: [1] Senan: Sandra! Look! — Sandra: Dolphins! They're dolphins! Look at them! They want to play with us! — Senan: Something is going wrong.
tasks.uz: [1] Senan: Sandra! Qara! — Sandra: Delfinlar! Bular delfinlar! Ularga qara! Biz bilan o'ynashni xohlashyapti! — Senan: Nimadir noto'g'ri ketyapti.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a dolphin' = delfin, 'ph' → /f/.
⚠ 'to go wrong' = noto'g'ri ketmoq, buzilmoq.
⚠ Akula kutilgan edi - delfin keldi.

tasks.en: [2] Sandra: Oh, no! It's raining! The man was right! — David: It looks like a storm is coming. Senan, quick, take us back to the shore!
tasks.uz: [2] Sandra: Voy, yo'q! Yomg'ir yog'yapti! O'sha odam haq ekan! — David: Bo'ron kelayotganga o'xshaydi. Senan, tez, bizni qirg'oqqa qaytar!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'It looks like + gap' = ... ga o'xshaydi.
⚠ 'a storm is coming' - PRESENT CONTINUOUS
yaqin kelajak uchun.
⚠ 'the shore' = qirg'oq.

tasks.en: [3] Senan: I can't. I can't move my arms! Someone has cast a spell on me.
tasks.uz: [3] Senan: Qila olmayman. Qo'llarimni qimirlata olmayman! Kimdir menga sehr qilgan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'Someone HAS CAST a spell' - PRESENT PERFECT
(7-unit mavzusi): natija hozir ko'rinib turibdi.
⚠ 'cast - cast - cast'.

tasks.en: [4] Sandra: David, we'll drown! Do something! — David: Give me the paddle.
tasks.uz: [4] Sandra: David, cho'kib ketamiz! Biror narsa qil! — David: Menga eshkakni ber.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to drown' = cho'kmoq (suvda).
⚠ "we'll drown" - taxmin, 'will'.
⚠ 'a paddle' = eshkak (qisqa).

tasks.en: BACK ON THE SHORE ... [5] Senan: You broke my spell. — Mosan: I did nothing! You are a fisherman, not a shark caller. — Senan: I am a shark caller!
tasks.uz: QIRG'OQDA ... [5] Senan: Sen mening sehrimni buzding. — Mosan: Men hech narsa qilmadim! Sen baliqchisan, akula chaqiruvchi emas. — Senan: Men akula chaqiruvchiMAN!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'broke' - 'break' ning o'tgan zamoni.
⚠ 'I AM a shark caller' - 'am' QIYa harflarda:
urg'u bilan aytilgan.

tasks.en: LEAVING THE VILLAGE ... [6] David: Let's get out of here before it starts raining again. — Sandra: Yes - I don't think there's much chance of seeing any sharks.
tasks.uz: QIShLOQDAN KETIShDA ... [6] David: Yana yomg'ir boshlanmasidan oldin bu yerdan ketaylik. — Sandra: Ha - menimcha, akula ko'rish ehtimoli katta emas.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to get out of here' = bu yerdan ketmoq.
⚠ 'before it STARTS' - vaqt ergash gapida
PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'much chance OF + -ING'.

tasks.en: [7] Sandra: David, look at this. This coconut is full of meat. That's how he was going to call the sharks!
tasks.uz: [7] Sandra: David, bunga qara. Bu kokos go'shtga to'la. U akulalarni MANA ShUNDAY chaqirmoqchi bo'lgan!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'full OF' = ... ga to'la.
⚠ "That's how ..." = mana shunday.
⚠ 'was going to' - o'tgandagi niyat (bajarilmagan).

tasks.en: [8] David: Well, that was certainly very interesting! — Sandra: I suppose I could make sharks appear with the meat, too. What do you think? — David: I'm sure you could!
tasks.uz: [8] David: Xo'sh, bu albatta juda qiziq bo'ldi! — Sandra: Menimcha, men ham go'sht bilan akulalarni paydo qila olardim. Nima deysan? — David: Ishonchim komil, qila olarding!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'I suppose' = menimcha, o'ylaymanki.
⚠ 'could' bu yerda = qila olardim (faraz).
⚠ 'to make sb/sth appear' = paydo qilmoq -
'make' + 'to' SIZ fe'l.

HIS-TUYG'U SIFATLARI.

     xursand

     'a puzzling story' = hayron
     qoldiradigan hikoya

exercises.explanationUz:
0-TUR ShART GAPLARI
(CONDITIONALS TYPE 0).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF/WHEN + PRESENT SIMPLE,
  PRESENT SIMPLE

  'If you HEAT water, it BOILS.'
  'When sharks SMELL meat, they GET
   excited.'

  ⚠ IKKALA bo'lakda ham PRESENT
  SIMPLE - 'will' YO'Q!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MA'NOSI                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HAR DOIM bo'ladigan NATIJA:
  tabiat qonunlari, odatlar,
  umumiy haqiqatlar.

  ⚠ 'if' = 'when' - bu turda
  ikkalasi bir xil ma'noda!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  0-TUR va 1-TUR FARQI            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  0-TUR: If you heat water, it
     BOILS. (har doim, qonun)
  1-TUR: If you heat the water,
     I'LL MAKE tea. (bir marta,
     kelajakda)

  ⚠ 1-tur 38-betda o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'TO HEAT':

  = isitmoq.
  ⚠ 'heat' (ot) = issiqlik.


⚠ 'TO BOIL':

  = qaynamoq / qaynatmoq.
  ⚠ 42-betdagi 9a mashqida.


⚠ 'TO GET EXCITED':

  = hayajonlanmoq.
  ⚠ 'get' + sifat = holat
  o'zgarishi.

tasks.en: if ... + present ... + present
tasks.uz: if ... + hozirgi zamon ... + hozirgi zamon

tasks.en: We can use conditionals Type 0 to talk about something which always happens as a result of something else.
tasks.uz: 0-tur shart gaplarini boshqa narsa natijasida har doim ro'y beradigan narsa haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'as a result of' = ... natijasida.
⚠ HAR DOIM - qonun, odat.

tasks.en: If you heat water, it boils.
tasks.uz: Agar suvni isitsang, u qaynaydi.

tasks.en: We can use when instead of if in conditionals Type 0.
tasks.uz: 0-tur shart gaplarida 'if' o'rniga 'when' ishlatishimiz mumkin.

tasks.en: If/When sharks smell meat, they get excited.
tasks.uz: Agar/Qachon akulalar go'sht hidini sezsa, hayajonlanadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'to smell' = hidlamoq, hid sezmoq.
⚠ 'get excited' = hayajonlanmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Expand the notes into full sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'If/When my dog hears the
   doorbell, it barks.'


TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  1 If/When my dog hears the
    doorbell, it barks.
  2 If/When you press this button,
    the camera takes a picture.
  3 If/When you put money in the
    machine, it gives you a ticket.
  4 If/When you mix red and yellow,
    you get orange.


⚠ 3-ShAXS BIRLIK '-S':

  'my dog HEARS', 'it BARKS',
  'the camera TAKES', 'it GIVES'
  ⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - '-s' ni
  unutmang!


⚠ 'TO BARK':

  = hurmoq (it).


⚠ 'TO PRESS A BUTTON':

  = tugmani bosmoq.
  ⚠ 'push' ham mumkin.


⚠ 'TO MIX':

  = aralashtirmoq.
  ⚠ 'a mixture' = aralashma.


⚠ 'IT' - IT HAQIDA:

  'my dog ... IT barks' - hayvon
  uchun 'it'.
  ⚠ O'z uy hayvoni bo'lsa 'he/she'
  ham mumkin.

exercises.explanationUz:
VAQT SO'ZLARIDAN KEYIN 'WILL' YO'Q.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QOIDA                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  before, after, while, until, if,
  when + PRESENT SIMPLE
  (kelajak haqida bo'lsa ham!)

  ✓ "Let's go before it STARTS
     raining."
  ✗ "Let's go before it WILL START
     raining."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ISTISNO - SAVOL SO'ZI 'WHEN'    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'when' SAVOL so'zi bo'lsa (qachon?)
  → 'will' MUMKIN:

  "I don't know WHEN Paul WILL
   COME." (qachon kelishini
   bilmayman - SAVOL)

  'Please tell me WHEN Paul COMES.'
  (Pol kelganda menga ayting -
   VAQT)

  ⚠ FARQNI QANDAY BILISh:
  'when' ni 'qachon' deb tarjima
  qilsa bo'lsa → savol so'zi → will
  'when' ni '...ganda' deb tarjima
  qilsa bo'lsa → vaqt so'zi →
  present simple


⚠ 'WHILE':

  = ... paytida, ... ekan.
  ⚠ 'while' + PRESENT SIMPLE /
  CONTINUOUS.


⚠ 'UNTIL':

  = ... gacha.
  ⚠ 'till' - so'zlashuv shakli.
  ⚠ "I won't do anything UNTIL
  everything IS ready."

tasks.en: Time Words
tasks.uz: Vaqt so'zlari

tasks.en: We do not use will after the time words before, after, while, until, if and when; we use the present simple instead.
tasks.uz: before, after, while, until, if va when vaqt so'zlaridan keyin 'will' ishlatmaymiz; o'rniga hozirgi oddiy zamonni ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
⚠ OLTI so'z: before, after, while, until,
if, when.

tasks.en: Let's go before it starts raining. (NOT: ... before it will start ...)
tasks.uz: Yomg'ir boshlanmasidan oldin ketaylik. (XATO: ... before it will start ...)

tasks.en: However when can be used with will if it is a question word.
tasks.uz: Biroq 'when' savol so'zi bo'lsa, 'will' bilan ishlatilishi mumkin.

tasks.en: I don't know when Paul will come. (question word) / Please tell me when Paul comes. (time word)
tasks.uz: Pol qachon kelishini bilmayman. (savol so'zi) / Pol kelganda menga ayting. (vaqt so'zi)

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs into the present simple or the future simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Fe'llarni hozirgi oddiy yoki kelasi oddiy zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  1 Give me the paddle before we
    DROWN!
    ⚠ 'before' → present simple
  2 If you DON'T DO something
    quickly, we'll be in trouble.
    ⚠ 'if' → present simple
  3 When WILL THE SHARKS APPEAR?
    ⚠ SAVOL so'zi 'when' → will!
  4 My dog gets annoyed if you PULL
    his tail.
    ⚠ 0-tur: if → present simple
  5 We'll talk to Mike about it when
    we GO back to England.
    ⚠ 'when' vaqt so'zi → present
    simple
  6 I won't do anything until
    everything IS ready.
    ⚠ 'until' → present simple


⚠ 3-BAND - YaGONA 'WILL':

  'When will the sharks appear?' -
  bu SAVOL (qachon?), shuning uchun
  'will'.
  ⚠ Savolda 'will' EGADAN OLDIN:
  'When WILL the sharks appear?'


⚠ 'TO GET ANNOYED':

  = jahli chiqmoq, bezovta bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'annoyed' - '-ed' sifati (his).


⚠ 'TO PULL':

  = tortmoq.
  ⚠ Aksi 'to push' = itarmoq.


⚠ 'A TAIL':

  = dum.
  ⚠ 'tale' (ertak) bilan BIR XIL
  o'qiladi: /teɪl/.


⚠ 'MIKE':

  1-qismdagi gazeta muharriri.

exercises.instructionUz: Qismni qayta o'qing va hozirgi davomli zamondagi uchta fe'l va o'tgan oddiy zamondagi uchta fe'lni toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
46-BETDAN FE'LLAR.


PRESENT CONTINUOUS (be + -ing):

  'Something IS GOING wrong.'
  "It'S RAINING!"
  'a storm IS COMING'


PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan oddiy):

  'The man WAS right!'
  'You BROKE my spell.'
  'I DID nothing!'
  'that WAS certainly very
   interesting'


⚠ NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:

  break - BROKE - broken
  do - DID - done
  be - WAS/WERE - been


⚠ 7b: 'Listen and follow the
  episode on p. 46, then act it
  out.' - audio kerak; keyin
  rollarga bo'lib o'ynang.

tasks.en: Read the episode again and find three verbs in the present continuous and three verbs in the past simple.
tasks.uz: Qismni qayta o'qing va hozirgi davomli zamondagi uchta fe'l va o'tgan oddiy zamondagi uchta fe'lni toping.

tasks.en: Present continuous: is going (wrong), is raining, is coming
tasks.uz: Hozirgi davomli: is going, is raining, is coming

tasks.en: Past simple: was (right), broke, did (nothing), was (interesting)
tasks.uz: O'tgan oddiy: was, broke, did, was

tasks.en: 7b) Listen and follow the episode on p. 46, then act it out.
tasks.uz: 7b) Tinglang va 46-betdagi qismni kuzatib boring, so'ng rollarda o'ynang.
tasks.note:
⚠ Audio kerak.
⚠ 'to act out' = rollarda o'ynamoq.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It looks like a storm is coming.
Someone has cast a spell on me.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PRESENT PERFECT - natija hozir ko'rinib
turibdi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Let's get out of here before it starts raining again.
That's how he was going to call the sharks!
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U akulalarni mana shunday chaqirmoqchi bo'lgan!
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ "That's how" = mana shunday, shu yo'l bilan.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If you heat water, it boils.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 0-TUR: har doim bo'ladigan natija.
⚠ Ikkala bo'lakda ham 'will' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: We'll talk to Mike when we go back to England.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Vaqt so'zidan keyin PRESENT SIMPLE, 'will'
faqat asosiy gapda.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Senan couldn't move his arms, so David asked for the paddle. / He was surprised because his magic didn't work.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Senan qo'llarini qimirlata olmadi, shuning uchun David eshkakni so'radi. / U hayron edi, chunki sehri ishlamadi.
